github_issue.title: ISS-0121-residual-29: drive T010 hardcoded-UUID MAJOR from 174 to <10
github_issue.body:
## Symptom
`tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration` reports `MAJOR=174` T010 hardcoded-UUID findings. The 17-file inventory in the design (`src/design/iss0121_per_test_uuids.md`) was stale; the on-disk linter baseline identifies **29 unique affected test files**, of which 5 were migrated in PR #399 follow-up (WF03-gh387-followup-20260802) and **24 still carry T010 findings**.

## Root cause
Multiple integration test files still INSERT hardcoded UUID literals (e.g. `00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000099`, `aaaaaaaa-...`, `11111111-...`, `e02050xx-...`) rather than using `TestHarness.newUuid` / `TestHarness.newUuidString`. Per INV-TI-3, all test fixtures must use per-test UUIDs to avoid deterministic collisions across runs.

## Migration plan
- Continue the incremental migration: replace each `00000000-...` / `aaaaaaaa-...` / `11111111-...` / `e02050xx-...` literal in the residual 24 files with a `harness.newUuid()` / `harness.newUuidString()` call.
- Run `python3 tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration` after each batch; target `MAJOR < 10`.
- Refresh `tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json` only after fixes land (never to mask new violations).
- Promote T010 to BLOCKER once the residual is below 10.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `python3 tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration` -> `MAJOR < 10` (currently 174)
- [ ] All 24 residual test files migrated to `TestHarness.newUuid*`
- [ ] `zig build test` and full integration suite remain green
- [ ] T010 promoted from MAJOR to BLOCKER in `tools/lint_test_isolation.py`

Found by: WF03-gh387-followup-20260802 Step 5 test run (cluster C).
